h: Google offers Nigerian students free AI subscription worth ₦92,400
p: Google is offering eligible university students in Nigeria and 26 other African countries 12 months of free access to its Google AI Plus plan, normally ₦7,700 a month.
body: Google is offering eligible higher-education students in Nigeria 12 months of free access to its AI subscription, a package worth about ₦92,400.
The promotion covers students in 27 African countries, including Nigeria. Google AI Plus normally costs ₦7,700 a month in Nigeria.
The package includes enhanced access to the Gemini assistant and other AI tools, including research and live conversation features, as well as 400GB of cloud storage.
The offer is aimed at eligible students in higher education institutions, who must verify their student status to claim it.
more: It covers students in 27 African countries.
